title: Accent Substitutions
intro: Lines where our reading puts a different mark than Google on the same letter (acute ↔ grave ↔ circumflex, smooth ↔ rough breathing). All are held today, so the label keeps Google’s mark. Full line crop with slot numbers; marks we detect boxed (green above, blue below); Google’s line, then ours with the mark swapped. Yellow = reader and detector agree, red = they do not. 20 random lines per group. No note = our line is right.
